name: Header Junk Remover
author: Joseph Brzezowski

sections.description:
Header Junk Remover is a lightweight plugin that cleans up the <head> section of your WordPress site by removing unnecessary tags and scripts that WordPress automatically adds.

This reduces clutter in your page source, improves performance, and avoids leaking information (like your WordPress version) that doesn’t need to be public.

What gets removed (and why):

  • WordPress Generator Tag
    remove_action( ‘wp_head’, ‘wp_generator’ );
    Hides your WordPress version. Helps reduce security risks by not advertising it.

  • RSD (Really Simple Discovery) Link
    remove_action( ‘wp_head’, ‘rsd_link’ );
    Used by old external editors. Not needed today.

  • Windows Live Writer Manifest
    remove_action( ‘wp_head’, ‘wlwmanifest_link’ );
    Legacy tool support. Safe to remove.

  • Shortlink Tag
    remove_action( ‘wp_head’, ‘wp_shortlink_wp_head’ );
    Removes the default WP shortlink (hardly used anymore).

  • REST API Discovery Link
    remove_action( ‘wp_head’, ‘rest_output_link_wp_head’ );
    Stops WP from advertising its REST endpoint in headers. The API still works, just isn’t broadcast.

  • Emoji Scripts and Styles
    remove_action( ‘wp_head’, ‘print_emoji_detection_script’, 7 );
    remove_action( ‘wp_print_styles’, ‘print_emoji_styles’ );
    Removes extra emoji scripts/styles. Browsers already handle emojis without them.

No theme edits required. Just install, activate, and your headers are instantly cleaned.

Requirements

WordPress 6.0.0 or greater

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/header-junk-remover, or install directly through the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. That’s it — no settings needed. The plugin automatically removes the junk.
sections.faq:
Will this break my site?

No. These are optional extras WordPress adds. Your site will run normally without them.

Can I re-enable something?

Yes, just comment out or remove the matching remove_action line in the main plugin file.

Does this affect SEO?

It can actually help by reducing clutter and unnecessary tags, but it doesn’t change your content or ranking factors.
